name: Neopentyl glycol dioleate
description: thoughtful text code Neopentyl glycol dioleate (CAS 42222-50-4 ) is a diester of neopentyl glycol and oleic acid used as a synthetic base fluid and functional additive in high-performance lubricant formulations. Its ester structure delivers strong lubricity and thermal stability, making it a preferred choice where petroleum-based fluids fall short. It is evaluated by formulators primarily for lubricant and plasticizer applications. In automotive and industrial lubricant blending, it functions as a synthetic base oil component or co-base fluid in gear oils, compressor oils, and hydraulic fluids requiring improved viscosity retention. Aerospace and defense lubricant manufacturers incorporate it into formulations for aircraft turbine oils and specialty greases where oxidative stability under extended service conditions is critical for safety. As a plasticizer, it is used in polymer processing to improve flexibility and processability in specific elastomer and synthetic rubber compounds. This enhances the durability of the final industrial product. Metalworking fluid formulators also use it as a lubricity additive in cutting and forming fluids to reduce tool wear and improve surface finish. This ensures high precision during the manufacturing process. Neopentyl glycol dioleate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in technical grade for industrial and lubricant applications, meeting standard commercial requirements for purity. Packaging typically ranges from drums to intermediate bulk containers (IBCs) depending on order volume. Proper storage in a cool, dry environment is recommended to maintain the chemical integrity of the ester.
